The '''Mos Eisley Salvage Yard''' was a huge [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] warehouses complex built in the outskirts of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. That facilty was the propriety of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself, and was guarded by a [[Mos Eisley Salvage Yard security droid|security droid]]. It was divided into several departments, including the fabrication assembly. The Salvage Yard housed an [[Optical Information Crystal]] that contained vital clues to the location of [[hidden droid factory]], where a [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|new series]] of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] were being made.
